Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Final Year Syllabus
Course Code: MCA-501: Advanced Cloud Computing and Distributed Systems
Academic Year: 2026-2027
Unit 1: Distributed Architecture Fundamentals
Distributed computing enables disparate machines to coordinate over a computer network. The primary objectives of distributed systems are scalability, fault tolerance, and transparency.

In Raft, leader election is triggered via randomized election timeouts ranging between 150ms and 300ms. Distributed hash tables (DHT) like Chord utilize consistent hashing with SHA-1 to map keys to nodes efficiently.

Unit 2: Microservices and Storage Systems

Unit 3: Final Examination Criteria and Project Grading
Final project assessment comprises 100 total marks broken into three components:
1. System Architecture and Implementation Quality: 50 Marks
2. Automated Test Suite and Code Documentation: 25 Marks
3. Viva Voce and Live Demonstration: 25 Marks
Minimum passing grade is 50% aggregate score. Plagiarism exceeding 15% results in immediate disqualification
Final project reports must be submitted in IEEE conference format before December 15th.
